scope_and_limitations: Standard, group S only; README and user define localhost disposable fixture contract. Source and real handler/SQLite checks only: socket bind denied; no network HTTP/browser verification. In-memory streams invoke original handlers and real database; only listening server class is captured. No production, TLS, race/load, brute-force, outside-workspace history or secret-store checks. No certification. S06 deferred. No committed HEAD; SHA-256 manifests identify source. After owner predicates added; historical failures retained in before/report.json.
